cohort: Women screened for Gestational Diabetes Mellitus (GDM) between March and June 2020 at antenatal clinics.
finding: The point-of-care (POC) measurement of capillary blood glucose (CBG) cannot entirely replace the laboratory method for the oral glucose tolerance test (OGTT) for gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) diagnosis, but it can be used to rule out/rule in GDM for specific glucose concentration thresholds.
